config.text:
# Author: Nicola Antonello
# E4: BM25 and Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B fused by reciprocal rank fusion, its constant k chosen
# by 5-fold cross-validation on dev from the grid ADR-0024 fixed before any run. No dense
# model was adopted, so the dense stage is the one with the highest dev recall@10, as E3
# ran it. A config that produced a committed run is never edited (ADR-0023).
name = "hybrid-rrf-qwen3-embedding"

[[first_stage]]
kind = "bm25"
k1 = 1.2
b = 0.75

[[first_stage]]
kind = "dense"
model = "Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B"
revision = "97b0c614be4d77ee51c0cef4e5f07c00f9eb65b3"
weights_sha256 = "0437e45c94563b09e13cb7a64478fc406947a93cb34a7e05870fc8dcd48e23fd"
query_prompt = "Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query\nQuery:"
max_length = 8192
dtype = "float32"

[fusion]
method = "rrf"
k = [10, 30, 60, 100]

[cv]
folds = 5
seed = "phase-3-folds-2026-11-25"
